releaseNotes: v1.9.5: Issue #25 — the Codex quota tracker was empty on every account because no fetcher existed for it; codex now reads live 5h/7d quota from the wham/usage endpoint, and a 429 carrying usage_limit_reached is cached so an exhausted account is skipped by the picker instead of being rediscovered by a failing request. Five other trackers (CodeBuddy, CommandCode, DeepSeek, Groq, Qoder) were failing on the same refused CONNECT tunnel and now retry directly. Ollama and Qoder quota parity. Dashboard backup import no longer dies at decode with 400: the client posts a JSON body instead of multipart, both buttons open a password modal, and a 401 shows the server's real reason instead of [object Object]; Escape no longer abandons an in-flight destructive import, and the two backup actions can no longer overlap. Issue #30 — the quota tracker fired every account in the same millisecond and Google answered 429, locking paid combos down with the free ones; dashboard quota reads are now throttled through a shared gate. Issue #28 — /v1/models can now report the models you can actually call (1302 verified against the listing). New: a Chat Completions to OpenAI Responses streaming translator plus four wiring paths that were missed in /v1/responses. Issue #27 — the update modal no longer opens inside the sidebar column. Qoder provider and OAuth parity; combo names can no longer collide with a model alias; Claude decloak recovers a tool name the map lost.
